event.distribution_pattern: Pure Source, Inc manufactured the recalled product for Baker's Best Health Products, Inc. They sold all of the the products to Baker's Best Health Products, Inc. in Wixom, MI who then distributed the products to their customers via catalog sales and internet sales. Baker's Best Health Products, Inc. distributed product throughout the U.S.

products.product_description: Baker's Best Maximum Mind & Memory Formula, 60 capsules, Vitamin B6 75 mg. Distributed by Baker's Best Health Products, Inc. Wixom, MI
products.reason_for_recall: Vitamin B6 level below percent declared on label
